title: Whole genome sequencing analysis identifies rare, large-effect non-coding variants and regions associated with circulating protein levels
authors: Hawkes G; Chundru K; Jackson L; Patel KA; Murray A; Wood AR; Wright CF; Weedon MN; Frayling TM; Beaumont RN
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过全基因组测序分析罕见非编码变异与循环蛋白水平关联，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，仅属基因组关联分析，与本课题关联度低。
abstract: The role of non-coding rare variation in common phenotypes is largely unknown, due to a lack of whole-genome sequence data, and the difficulty of categorising non-coding variants into biologically meaningful regulatory units. To begin addressing these challenges, we performed a cis association analysis using whole-genome sequence data, consisting of 391 million variants and 1,450 circulating protein levels in ∼20,000 UK Biobank participants. We identified 777 independent rare non-coding single variants associated with circulating protein levels ( P <1×10 -9 ), after conditioning on protein-coding and common associated variants. Rare non-coding aggregate testing identified 108 conditionally independent regulatory regions. Unlike protein-coding variation, rare non-coding genetic variation was almost as likely to increase as decrease protein levels. The regions we identified overlapped predicted tissue-specific enhancers more than promoters, suggesting they represent tissue-specific regulatory regions. Our results have important implications for the identification, and role, of rare non-coding variation associated with common human phenotypes.
abstract_zh: 非编码罕见变异在常见表型中的作用在很大程度上是未知的，这归因于全基因组序列数据的缺乏，以及将非编码变异分类为具有生物学意义的调控单元的困难。为着手解决这些挑战，我们利用全基因组序列数据进行了顺式关联分析，该数据包含3.91亿个变异及约20,000名英国生物银行参与者中1,450种循环蛋白水平。在针对蛋白质编码及常见关联变异进行条件调整后，我们识别出777个独立的罕见非编码单变异与循环蛋白水平相关（P <1×10⁻⁹）。罕见非编码聚合测试确定了108个条件独立的调控区域。与蛋白质编码变异不同，罕见非编码遗传变异增加蛋白水平的可能性几乎与降低蛋白水平相当。我们识别的区域与预测的组织特异性增强子重叠多于启动子，表明它们代表组织特异性调控区域。我们的结果对识别罕见非编码变异及其在常见人类表型中的作用具有重要意义。
